deltas.topic: ported Tensor Core and Q4 schedules
facts: Both targets are separately compiled images with architecture-specific tuning authorities.
A GInfer SM89 Q4 specialization was later admitted on SM86 by an explicit compile-time guard change.
non_transfer_rules: The source port does not transfer RTX 4090 latency, occupancy, or acceptance measurements to RTX 3090.
Runtime correctness and the complete performance matrix must be measured on physical SM86 hardware.

deltas.topic: resource policy, data movement, and architecture-specific features
facts: Blackwell compute capability 12.0 has different documented occupancy and shared-memory limits from Ada.
GInfer builds sm_89 and sm_120a as separate exact images and admits architecture-specific routes explicitly.
non_transfer_rules: Do not transplant an Ada tile, launch bound, or cache policy without compiling and measuring the Blackwell route.
Do not treat an sm_120a compile as proof that an architecture-specific instruction executes on sm_89.

facts: RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell execute the same GInfer sm_120a image.
non_transfer_rules: Keep latency, bandwidth, live free memory, SM count, thermals, and qualification status separate by SKU and host.
